scope: Public Top-2 spectator replay audit. Observational action counts.

method.opening: Submitted actions at t=0 on ordered base IDs 0 and 1; C=collector, P=planter.
method.bands: Per appearance [roots with at least one submitted purchase, eligible roots]. Eligible means t>0, pre-action cash >=30 and fewer than 10 own workers. Root is one player decision across BOTH bases. No survival, profitability or independence of repeated roots is implied. All bands are inclusive.
method.original: Previously studied; last fifth is a descriptive temporal split only.
method.later: Nine additional matches have timestamps after every original match. Separate confirmation of the two frozen opening predictions.
method.visibility: Only own cash, workers, own bases, configuration and submitted actions enter action counts. Observer scores and seat order validate replay identity.
